title: Serra | Planeswalker
description: Learn more about the Planeswalker Serra, from Magic: The Gathering.

paragraphs.text: A human Planeswalker from the distant past, Serra was a powerful and benevolent healer. She created an artificial plane known as Serra's Realm, where she and her followers lived in peace defended by flights of angels. Though Serra and her realm are long gone, her legacy and teachings have lived on as a beacon of hope throughout the Multiverse.
